AMATH 251: Introduction to Differential Equations (Advanced Level)
Description: AMATH 251 is an advanced-level version of AMATH 250. This course offers a more theoretical treatment of differential equations and solution methods. In addition, emphasis will be placed on computational analysis of differential equations and on applications in science and engineering.
Requirements: Prereq: (One of MATH 106, 114, 115, 136, 146, NE 112) and (One of MATH 118, 119, 128, 138, 148). Antireq: AMATH 250, 350, MATH 218, 228
